_comment: Public site configuration. `goatcounterCode` is the GoatCounter site code (https://<code>.goatcounter.com); an empty value removes the tracking snippet and hides the visitor panel. `goatcounterPath` is the path stored by GoatCounter and aggregated in the CI snapshot; GoatCounter normalizes a trailing slash away, so the challenge site is `/atm26`, not `/atm26/`. See README.md.
